hero.heading: Rec Room: A New Semester Game: Steam Details and Starter Guide
hero.lead: Rec Room: A New Semester is an upcoming free-to-play multiplayer game launching on Steam as Early Access on November 24, 2026. Developed by Thunderstorm Games, it offers cross-platform co-op, PvP, user-generated rooms, and optional VR support across Meta Quest, Valve Index, Vive, and PSVR2. Below you'll find the verified Steam entry point, minimum PC specs, platform availability, gameplay features, and starter resources.

sections.heading: Developer, Publisher, and Steam Store Entry Point
sections.intro: Rec Room: A New Semester is developed and published by Thunderstorm Games. The game is listed on Steam as a free-to-play Early Access title, so there is no purchase price to wishlist or download it at launch.
paragraphs: You can find the official Steam page by searching "Rec Room: A New Semester" directly in the Steam store. Adding it to your wishlist now will trigger a notification when the November 24, 2026 release goes live. The Steam listing confirms genres of Action, Casual, Indie, and Massively Multiplayer, with features including online co-op, online PvP, cross-platform multiplayer, and Steam Achievements.

sections.intro: Rec Room: A New Semester launches on Steam as Early Access on November 24, 2026. The game is listed as Coming Soon on the Steam store and will be free to play at launch. Early Access means the development team will continue adding features, rooms, and optimizations based on player feedback after the initial release.
paragraphs: You can wishlist the game now on Steam to receive a notification when it becomes available for download. sections.heading: Platform Availability: PC, VR, and Cross-Platform Play
sections.intro: Rec Room: A New Semester launches on Steam for PC and supports cross-platform multiplayer, so players on different devices can join the same rooms. VR is fully supported but entirely optional — the game runs on a standard monitor without a headset.
paragraphs: For VR players, the confirmed compatible headsets are Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Valve Index, HTC Vive, and PSVR2. No additional VR headsets are listed in the Steam specs at this time.

PC players without VR hardware can participate in every multiplayer mode, including co-op and PvP. The Steam listing notes the game does not require a powerful computer to run, and the minimum specs reflect that — full hardware details are covered in the system requirements section below.

sections.heading: PC System Requirements and Hardware Recommendations
sections.intro: Rec Room: A New Semester requires modest hardware to run on PC. The minimum specifications are Windows 10, 8 GB of RAM, an NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290-class graphics card, DirectX 11, a broadband internet connection, and 5 GB of available storage space. These requirements reflect the game's design to remain accessible across a wide range of PC configurations rather than demanding high-end components.
paragraphs: The stated minimum processor requirement is an Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350, both of which are several generations old and widely available in used or budget systems. If your PC meets these baseline specs, you should be able to install and launch the game without performance issues. The 5 GB storage footprint is relatively modest for a multiplayer title, making it feasible even on drives with limited free space.

Since Rec Room: A New Semester supports optional VR across Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Valve Index, HTC Vive, and PSVR2, players with VR headsets can choose to play in virtual reality on compatible PC setups. However, VR capability is not required; the game runs as a standard PC client for mouse-and-keyboard or controller-based play. If you plan to use VR, ensure your PC meets or exceeds the minimum specs and has adequate USB ports and space for sensor placement.

sections.heading: Gameplay Overview: Rooms, Creation Tools, and Multiplayer
sections.intro: Rec Room: A New Semester centers on exploring and creating shared spaces called rooms. Players can hang out in official rooms curated by Thunderstorm Games, browse thousands of community-created rooms, or build their own using the in-game level editor. The game supports online co-op and PvP modes, letting you team up with friends or compete against other players in real time. Cross-platform multiplayer means PC and VR users can join the same sessions, and Steam Achievements track your progress across activities.
paragraphs: Official rooms provide polished, ready-to-play experiences spanning action, casual, and MMO-style gameplay. Community creations range from mini-games and social hangouts to elaborate puzzle maps and competitive arenas. Whether you prefer socializing, completing co-op challenges, or testing your skills in PvP matches, the room system gives you a persistent hub to discover new content and return to your favorite spaces. The level editor is accessible in-game, so you can start building and sharing your own rooms without external tools.

faq.question: What is Rec Room: A New Semester?
faq.answer: Rec Room: A New Semester is a free-to-play multiplayer game developed by Thunderstorm Games, launching on Steam as Early Access on November 24, 2026. It features user-generated rooms, cross-platform co-op and PvP, optional VR support, and a built-in level editor for creating custom experiences.

faq.question: Do I need a VR headset to play Rec Room: A New Semester?
faq.answer: No. The game supports Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Valve Index, Vive, and PSVR2, but VR is optional. You can play on a standard Windows 10 PC with a keyboard and mouse or controller, making it accessible to both VR and non-VR players in the same sessions.

faq.question: What are the minimum PC requirements for Rec Room: A New Semester?
faq.answer: You need Windows 10, an Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350 processor, 8 GB RAM, an NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 graphics card, DirectX 11, a broadband internet connection, and 5 GB of available storage. The Steam page notes it doesn't require a powerful computer to run.

faq.question: When is Rec Room: A New Semester coming to Steam?
faq.answer: The official Steam launch date is November 24, 2026. The game will enter Early Access on that date, meaning ongoing development and feature updates are planned after release. You can wishlist it now on the Steam store page.

faq.question: Can I play Rec Room: A New Semester with friends on different platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. The Steam listing confirms cross-platform multiplayer, allowing PC, VR headset, and other supported platform users to join the same rooms and sessions. This includes online co-op and PvP modes across devices.
